publication.scope: Every reviewed dictionary entry deterministically extracted from the three pinned 2011 PDF volumes.
publication.access: Static JSON chunks preserve the source wordform, frequency, morphemic analysis, combined lemma-and-morphology text, volume, and source page.

provenance.modificationNotice: MODIFIED FILE: Deterministically extracted and reviewed by the dazniausi-zodziai Lithuanian word project from the three 2011 dictionary PDFs; this derivative is not an official VDU database export.
downstreamRequirements: Retain the attribution notice and identify the files as a modified derivative when redistributing the dataset or statistics.

method.normalization: Unicode NFC; source text otherwise preserved
method.rowOrder: PDF volume order I, II, III; page order; top-to-bottom order
method.continuationPolicy: A pure x >= 285 pt line is buffered: it is prepended to the next same-page row only when that row's description lacks a semicolon; otherwise it is appended to the preceding row, including across page boundaries.
method.splitFragmentPolicy: A reviewed non-row split line is joined to its adjacent row using source-layout direction; forward joins require the next row on the same page within 17 pt. Every split-line digest must match the manifest set.

constraints: Publish only entries reproduced by the reviewed deterministic extractor from the three pinned PDF volumes.
Retain the source frequency as a corpus-scoped raw count, not a general Lithuanian-language ranking.
Retain duplicate wordforms, source order, volume and printed-page provenance, and the literal combined lemma-and-morphology field.
Carry the rightsholder-permission basis, attribution notice, and modification notice with the public product.
Do not present this PDF derivative as an export or snapshot of the separate live Morfema database.

views.title: Morphemic dictionary entries
